ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels; high macro-level contrast with sharp, non-gradient boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Predominantly low-intensity (black) contiguous mass with high-intensity (white) mottling on the distal-lateral edge. Right lobe: Large central contiguous high-intensity (white) region bordered by low-intensity (black) pixels at the base and tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 55-degree pixel angle relative to the fluke mid-plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; highest amplitude variations localized at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to the lateral tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, rough-textured pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; several small dark circular spots within the white region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, nearly parallel horizontal dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the mid-distal white region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct rake marks on the right ventral lobe; irregular, possibly traumatic erosion at the extreme distal tips.
